source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U21: Apply GST supply,place-of-supply and input-credit concepts using stipulated calculation rates

payload.title: A cross-border payment is not a complete GST analysis
payload.core_explanation_md:
GST concerns the taxable supply and its applicable classification, valuation and place-of-supply rules. The source distinguishes the intra-State dual structure from the inter-State IGST structure. Input tax credit reduces eligible output liability subject to the actual statutory conditions; possession of any invoice is not an unlimited credit entitlement.

An import-of-services analysis needs the provider location, recipient location and place of supply, plus the relevant consideration or specified related/distinct-person rules. Paying in foreign currency alone does not establish every element. Exercises below stipulate a rate and eligible credit to teach arithmetic, not to certify a current banking-service tax treatment.

self_check.prompt_text: Does foreign-currency payment alone prove an import of services?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The location, place-of-supply and applicable scope conditions matter.

payload.title: Separate output tax from stipulated eligible credit
payload.core_explanation_md: For a hypothetical taxable fee of INR 24,000, use a stipulated total GST rate18% and eligible usable input credit INR 1,200. Assume no other adjustments. Calculate net tax for this exercise only.

self_check.prompt_text: Which rule and stipulated facts determine this result?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Use the sourced rule and stated scenario assumptions; the arithmetic does not establish a live legal entitlement.

payload.stem_md: For a hypothetical fee INR 36,000, use stipulated total GST18% and eligible usable credit INR 1,800. No other adjustments apply. Compute net tax in exact INR. This does not determine a live service tax rate or credit eligibility.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Use exact whole units; do not round intermediate values.

options.explanation_md: Currency alone does not establish import scope.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The required geographical and scope facts must be established.
